newsitem.title: UK: S&P affirms Alcatel, long-term outlook negative.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms Alcatel, long-term outlook negative.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Thursday it had affirmed and removed from CreditWatch senior debt, medium-term notes, and commercial paper ratings of Alcatel Alsthom and its guaranteed subsidiaries.
The rating were placed on watch on September 20, 1996 with negative implications, S&P said.
But it added that the long-term rating outlook is negative.
S&P said the CreditWatch placement had resulted from Alcatel's official bid for the French defense and consumer electronics group Thomson SA -- rated A minus/A2.
"The affirmation follows the French government's recent choice of the other bidder, France's defense and media group Lagardere, as the buyer of its interest in Thomson," it said in a statement.
It said the rating action was conditional on this preference being converted into a final decision of the Privatization Commission, which it said was "very likely".
RATINGS AFFIRMED AND REMOVED FROM CREDITWATCH NEGATIVE:
Alcatel Alsthom Inc. (GTD: Alcatel Alsthom S.A.)
Alsthom Finance Inc. Alcatel Alsthom Finance Ltd.
